subject: Next steps & procurement checklist for Acero Health — vendor enablement items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & procurement checklist for Redwood Pilot (Acero Health)

Hi Lina — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the pilot procurement moving: 

Summary of call
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for production inference for patient-facing triage (low latency, predictable cost).
- Decision criteria you called out: latency SLAs, data handling/residency, SOC2 evidence, and unit economics at expected QPS.
- Stakeholders: you (program lead), procurement, security, and economic buyer (if you confirm).

What we can provide now (attached)
- Redwood vendor packet (vendor_packet.pdf) — includes SOC2 summary, security whitepaper, and standard terms
- Pricing sheet (inline) — ballpark numbers for a 3-month pilot and annual commitment options

Requests / ask of Acero
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and their preferred cadence for a short decision readout? (you mentioned Rafael Ortiz)
2) Who should we send the vendor onboarding packet to (procurement contact + security contact)?
3) Procurement items we anticipate: W9, COI/insurance, security questionnaire, PO terms (Net30/Net45), and an initial SOW/DocuSign path.
4) Desired timeline — you mentioned "end of March" as a target for vendor enablement; can you confirm constraints?

Next steps from Redwood
- We will prepare a slim vendor bundle (W9, sample SLA, SOC2 link) for procurement and a short SOW to expedite DocuSign.
- Suggest a 30-minute alignment call with Rafael + procurement + security this week if possible.

Files attached: vendor_packet.pdf (summary), pricing-sheet.csv (ballpark)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the W9 and the SOC2 link once I confirm the right procurement contact.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lina Alvarez <lina.alvarez@acerohealth.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acerohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap & procurement checklist for Redwood Pilot (Acero Health)

Thanks Jordan — good recap. A few clarifications from procurement and next items from our side: 

Procurement path (high level)
- Intake -> Security review -> Vendor onboarding -> Finance issues PO -> Legal signs SOW
- Typical docs we require: completed vendor intake form, W9, COI (certificate of insurance), SOC2 Type II report or AICPA bridge letter, and a sample SLA.
- Payment: standard is Net30 but can discuss Net45 for newer vendors; insurance and indemnity language are negotiated by legal.

Contacts / Stakeholders
- Economic buyer: Rafael Ortiz (Chief Digital Officer) — rafael.ortiz@acerohealth.com. He prefers a 15-minute readout following security sign-off.
- Procurement point: procurement@acerohealth.com (I CC’d them).
- Security: I’ll loop in our security tech lead separately; for now, send security artifacts to procurement and to security@acerohealth.com.

Decision criteria reminder
- Latency (p95 under target for triage flows), SOC2 attestation, ability to support VPC/private deployment if needed for PHI, and predictable unit cost.

Timeline
- If we can get the intake and SOC2 link this week, onboarding + security review could finish by 3/20 and PO issuance by ~3/25, assuming no major legal redlines. That aligns with our end-of-March target.

I attached the vendor_intake_form.pdf for you to complete. Also — please provide a sample SLA and W9 as soon as you can.

Lina
Program Manager, Digital Innovation
Acero Health
lina.alvarez@acerohealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3321
